info.name: Garage Parts — Full Marketplace & Realtime API Collection
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman collection for Garage Parts Marketplace API.

### Features Included:
1. **System & Health**: API health, DB/cache/queue probes, Laravel uptime, CSRF cookie initialization.
2. **Authentication & Session**: Register (Buyer/Seller), Login (Admin/Seller/Buyer), OAuth redirect/callback, Profile (`/auth/me`), Role probes, Single & All-device Logout.
3. **Cars Marketplace & Inventory**: Public catalog with search/filter/sort/pagination, Seller CRUD, Publish/Unpublish/Mark-Sold lifecycle, and multi-media array uploads.
4. **Parts Marketplace & Inventory**: Public catalog with category/condition/price filters, Seller CRUD, Publish/Unpublish/Mark-Sold lifecycle, and multi-media array uploads.
5. **Real-time WebSocket & Broadcasting (Laravel Reverb)**: Channel authorization (`/api/v1/broadcasting/auth`) for private user channels (`private-user.{id}`), seller channels (`private-seller.{id}`), and presence marketplace (`presence-marketplace`).
6. **Nginx Caching & Edge Performance**: Verifications for FastCGI microcaching (`X-Cache-Status` HIT/MISS/BYPASS), authenticated cache bypass, and Cache-Control headers.

### Automated Workflow:
- Registering or Logging in automatically captures the Bearer `{{token}}` and `{{userId}}`.
- Creating cars or parts automatically saves `{{carId}}` and `{{partId}}` for downstream updates and state transitions.
- All requests include functional post-response test assertions.
